contexts.text: If he does not perceive in himself something of affection... for what is true and good in company and in life, he may know that he is in the same delight as the infernals...
They are outside the Church, although they are within the congregation... AC 3963:end.
God stood in the congregation of God ().
A nation and a company of nations shall be from thee () = good, and the Divine forms of good... A company of nations = the truths which are from good, or what is the same, the forms of good.

The reason a company of nations = the forms of good, is that nations = goods, and therefore a company or congregation of them is a collection of them, which is nothing else but a form... Moreover, in the Word, company, congregation, and multitude are predicated of truths.
A company of such men make the Church in general.
I will give thee for a company of peoples () = indefinite increase. A company of peoples = truths from good to an indefinite number; for company = abundance.

Speak to all the congregation of Israel () = influx with information of all things which are of the Spiritual Church... The congregation of Israel = all truths and goods in the complex; for by the congregation of Israel are meant all the tribes... AC 8006. AC 8193. AC 8398. AC 8403. AC 8438. AC 8557.
The congregation of the company () = the truths of good which are with those of the Spiritual Church; for congregation is predicated of truth, and company of good.
There must be governors who will keep the assemblages of men in order...
Every man... thinks of a company of men as a man...
No one there can sit anywhere except in his own place... It is the same in companies.
This is why as soon as he comes into companies he inverts his spirit...
There are three companies of them... These three companies receive enlightenment from the Angels who are directly over them.
The Angels arranged them all in four companies...
The four companies formed themselves all into one, but after conversing together about what the Angel had said, they were divided into four different companies...
The congregation of God () = Heaven.
Divine truth from Divine good is signified by, the princes of Judah their company ().
The congregation of God = the Angels, by whom in the spiritual sense are signified Divine truths.
The inheritance of God, by which is meant the Church, is called thy wild beast, thy congregation shall dwell therein ().
That the Church is to be established from them is signified by, I am bringing them, I will gather them, and a great company shall return thither ().
The company of these men is what is called the Church. In this company or Church are they who live according to the order described above.
